title: Training Sheet: Cleaning Deductible Allowance and the HostCover Deductible (Listings)
content:
# Training Sheet — Cleaning Deductible Allowance

*Host Support training, Roamhaven Listings.*

## The rule

On top of the standard cleaning-fee ceiling, a listing may carry a cleaning deductible allowance, worked out on the day of the cleaning-fee reset. The host bears the plan's deductible on every deep-cleaning claim, so the allowance follows the deductible of the HostCover level that the listing's active Host Damage Protection (HostCover) plan holds:

| Deductible of the HostCover level on the listing's active plan | Cleaning deductible allowance |
|---|---|
| at least $500.00 | $20.00 |
| at least $250.00 and below $500.00 | $10.00 |
| below $250.00 | none |

The allowance is added to the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling.

## Questions and answers

**Why does a higher deductible give a larger allowance?**
Because the host bears the plan's deductible on every deep-cleaning claim.

**The deductible is exactly $500.00.**
That is "at least $500.00": $20.00.

**The deductible is exactly $250.00.**
That is "at least $250.00 and below $500.00": $10.00.

**The deductible is $249.99.**
Below $250.00: no cleaning deductible allowance.

**Which plan is read when the host has had several HostCover plans on the listing?**
The listing's active plan, and the deductible of the HostCover level it holds.
